messages:
Alex Kim: Quick status — private deploy for Meridian preflight. We're green on infra but two network items: NAT mapping for egress and offline registry cert rotation.
Maria Lopez: NAT mapping — I confirmed with NetEng, need public IPs from customer till tunnel is up. Waiting on ticket from them. Pinged @Meridian-ops yesterday.
Jin Park: Registry certs — airgapped customers require s3-mirror + local registry. Lia and I tested image sync, CA chain expired on 2026-02-10, fixed with self-signed workaround. Need final HSM pin to rotate real certs.
Samir Patel: Can we get a roll-forward plan if image sync fails? Remediation options?
Lia Chen: Yes — fallback: use cached images + strict mode disabled for 1hr. Command to pre-pull:
```
# on customer host
crane cp gcr.io/redwood/runtime:1.4.2 file://local-registry/runtime:1.4.2
```
Maria Lopez: Ownership: NetEng -> public IPs, Infra -> registry bake, Security -> cert sign. Who owns the CR to Meridian for IPs?
Alex Kim: Assigned NetEng: @Jin Park please confirm you're OK to own CR until they provide IPs.
Jin Park: I can own it. Created CR-8723. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CR-8723
eng-oncall: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-02 03:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: Blocker: customer's firewall team flagged outbound 443 restrictions to our telemetry endpoint. Need an egress fallback to region endpoint in eu-west-1.
Lia Chen: Can we expose alternate endpoint on port 8443? Security needs to approve.
Maria Lopez: Security review in progress, ETA 8 hours. @Security please chime in.
Alex Kim: Quick ask — everyone confirm readiness by EOD PST. If any red tickets call out now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Security: security-bot: Approved alternate port under conditional ACLs, pending customer signed AUP. See doc: https://redwood.infra/docs/priv-deploys/egress-ports
Jin Park: Updated CR-8723 with firewall exception details and fallback plan. Added test steps.
Samir Patel: I'll schedule preflight smoke for 2026-03-01 16:00 PST. Invite sent.
Maria Lopez: Great. One more — offline image v1.4.2 has patch fix for metrics. Confirmed with runtime team. No regression expected.
Alex Kim: Cool. Closing loop: NetEng owns IPs, Jin owns CR, Lia owns image sync ops, Security owns cert sign. If anyone wants to swap ping here. :thumbsup:
Lia Chen: noted. I'll run image pre-pull during smoke and post results.
eng-oncall: deploy-bot: Reminder: rotate tokens 24h before cutover.
Alex Kim: thanks all — keep async updates here.
